description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs tests: smime_policy tests (lines 419-495) and code_signing_policy tests (lines 501-552) are primarily field-value assertions against the returned ValidationPolicy struct (e.g., assert_eq!(p.max_validity_secs, Some(1185*86400))). The integration tests that call validate_path only test rejection cases (cert with serverAuth rejected by smime_policy). There is no passing test that validates an S/MIME or code-signing certificate with the appropriate EKU and SAN through the full chain with smime_policy/code_signing_policy. The smime_policy test named smime_policy_email_protection_eku_passes() (line 455) has a misleading name — it actually tests rejection (serverAuth cert failing emailProtection requirement). Compare to web_pki_policy which has web_pki_conforming_cert_passes() with a genuine end-to-end passing fixture. Adding fixtures with emailProtection and codeSigning EKUs and running full validate_path calls would increase confidence.
title: smime_policy test coverage is mostly oracle-only field assertions, no end-to-end validation test
